newsitem.title: USA: Home Health Corp unit signs Multi Plan pact.
newsitem.headline: Home Health Corp unit signs Multi Plan pact.

text.p: HHCA Health Alliance said Tuesday it signed an agreement with private firm Multi Plan to provide services to their member network.

Under the contract, HHCA Health Alliance will offer discounted fees for home health services to members of Multi Plan's nationwide preferred provider network, comprised of 2,600 hospitals and more than 100,000 physicians, HHCA Health Alliance said in a statement.
"We are very excited about this contract because of the Multi Plan's vast network of affiliated hospitals and physicians," said HHCA chief executive Bruce Feldman.
HHCA Health Alliance is a new division of Home Health Corp of America Inc, a provider of home health services, delivering nursing and related patient services.
